description: Global internet media company and trusted publisher of travel, entertainment and local deals, whose deals average 40–50% savings; local-deal vouchers and hotels are booked through travelzoo.com.

evidence.summary: Travelzoo's own Awin merchant profile (US & Canada program, AID 6394) states a standard commission of 4% on the sale amount for local deals and getaways and 4% for hotel deals booked on its platform, with commission approved post-consumption. The profile also states publisher applications generally want a minimum of 500K unique visitors or 50K+ subscribers, with exceptions possible — an eligibility threshold, not a creator count, so creator_saturation is unknown. Two conflicts are documented and not used: an older Awin publisher cheat sheet lists Travelzoo at 8%, and LinkClicky lists a flat $2–$5 per sale. The current merchant profile's 4% is recorded. No earnings-cap statement appears, so commission_cap is unknown.
